answer: Each identity must hold a licensed marriage and family therapist credential: a therapy degree, supervised clinical hours, and a licensing exam, one licence per person. No one can fake a voyage of therapists, since every licence needs its own degree and hours. A licence costs about $300, so ten fakes cost $3,000 and ten exams; each extra fake adds $300 more, and an oasis of verified session records echoes every duplicate back to the register.
